 SPRINGFIELD, Ore. — Springfield Municipal Jail records indicate that a person identified as Evan Stewart was booked into jail at approximately 7 a.m. Sunday, October 18, on a charge of driving under the influence of intoxicants (DUII).
 According to the information provided, Stewart was released approximately one hour later, at 8 a.m., to a third party whose name matches that of another Oregon Ducks wide receiver.
 KATU reached out to the University of Oregon football program seeking confirmation and a statement regarding the reported booking but had not received a response at the time of publication.
 The reported booking comes after social media posts circulated alleging that multiple Oregon Ducks football players had been arrested. KATU News was only able to find one name linking to the social media post.
 KATU will update this story if additional information becomes available or the University of Oregon responds.
